custom_logic_notes: Uses two custom indicators: BykovTrend (signal generator) and ColorX2MA (trend filter/direction confirmation). Entry requires both indicators to agree on direction. Signal reversal closes opposite position before entering new one. Digit adjustment applied: SL/TP multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001. Lot sizing has dual mode: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction with margin check.
python_conversion_notes: Both BykovTrend and ColorX2MA are custom indicators whose logic must be reimplemented in Python. BykovTrend appears to be a signal-based indicator (buy/sell arrows) likely derived from ATR-based trend detection. ColorX2MA is a dual moving average with color-coded direction. The EA uses new-bar gating so bar-level data suffices. Digit adjustment logic for SL/TP must be handled based on symbol precision. The dual-mode lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=deposit fraction) requires careful implementation with margin validation.
